source: EFLM Biological Variation Database (biologicalvariation.eu), global within-subject CVI, accessed 2026-10-24; CVA set to the desirable specification 0.5 x CVI

crp.note: EFLM advises against BV-based targets for CRP; CVA set to a typical hs-CRP assay 5%

lymph_pct.note: no lymphocyte % entry; absolute lymphocyte CVI used (one included % dataset has CVI 10.8)

rdw.note: EFLM RDW entry mixes RDW-SD and two RDW-CV datasets (2.0, 3.7); midpoint 2.7 used
